name: Yuuki Ryouka
source: The class representative of Kei's class and the daughter of Yuuki Group, which secretly, is in the final part of bankruptcy. Well known for her beauty and intelligent, she often got into fight with Miki and to the lesser extent, Midori, for the latter friendship with Miki. Despite her arrogance, Ryouka takes interest in Kei and soon falls for him.
